HUTAOMOD-HUAN_YANG.title: Return
HUTAOMOD-HUAN_YANG.description: Put cards from the top of your discard pile on top of your draw pile and give them Spirit.
HUTAOMOD-SPIRIT.title: Spirit
HUTAOMOD-SPIRIT.description: When this card is played, its effect is empowered once: Attacks deal +50% damage, Skills apply +1 stack, and it costs 1 less. After being played it becomes Spirit (Spent).
HUTAOMOD-SPIRIT_SPENT.title: Spirit (Spent)
HUTAOMOD-SPIRIT_SPENT.description: This card's Spirit has already been spent, so it is no longer empowered. It still counts as a Spirit card when drawn (Fate's Journey and similar cards gain Energy from it).
HUTAOMOD-SAMSARA.title: Samsara
HUTAOMOD-SAMSARA.description: At the start of your turn, gain 2x stacks Block, then halve your stacks. Some cards spend stacks to deal damage.
